Notification No. NPSC/EXAM-7/2022 dt. 18.08.2026 (Combined Technical Services Examination 2026) 
 Published on : 19-08-2026 11:08 am 
 NAGALAND
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC/EXAM-7/2022 Dated Kohima, the 18 th August
2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 In continuation of the Commission’s
Advertisement No.NPSC-2/CTSE-2026 dated 25 th June 2026, this is
to notify that the Written Examination of 
 Combined Technical Services Examination 2026 is tentatively scheduled to commence
from 26 th September 2026 onwards. 
 Note: 
 1. 
 The routine containing details of
Examination shall be uploaded on the Commission’s website and on the Notice
Board at a later date. 
 2. 
 Item No. 16 Food Safety Officer: All the
candidates who have opted for Food Safety Officer have been assigned the common
syllabus of Food Safety Officer. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA 
 IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission
